name: 李有豐
objective:
本課程將介紹
1. 變分法        2. 線性彈性力學       3. 變分法應用到彈性力學
4.Euler 梁與 Timoshenko 梁      5. 扭力    6. 古典板理論
7. 彈性穩定.
This course will introduces:
1.Calculus of Variations
2.Linear Elasticity
3.Variational Principles of Elasticity
4.Euler Beam and Timoshenko Beam
5.Torsion
6.Classical Theory of Plates
7.Elastic Stability
課程進度(1-16週):
Week: 1~2  Calculus of Variations
Week: 3~5 Linear Elasticity
Week: 6~8 Variational Principles of Elasticity
Week: 9 Midterm Exam
Week: 10~11 Euler Beam and Timoshenko Beam
Week: 12~12 Torsion
Week: 13~13 Classical Theory of Plates
Week: 14~15 Elastic Stability
Week: 16 Final Exam
Week: 17~18 彈性學習規劃
